title: Alert creation journey: microcopy, SLO visual editor, and shift handoff timeline
creator: Ava Chen
description: Goal: Design an end-to-end alert creation and SLO tuning experience in the Redwood Console that reduces configuration errors, clarifies operator responsibilities during handoff, and surfaces postmortem links and runbook attachments at the moment of incident triage. Scope includes: alert creation wizard microcopy, an inline SLO visual editor with traffic and error budget sliders, a handoff timeline UI for on-call transfers, and lightweight postmortem quicklinks on the alert detail panel. Excludes backend policy enforcement and RBAC rules (engineering will own enforcement).
acceptance_criteria: 1) Designers deliver a clickable prototype for the alert wizard (create/edit) covering three flows: threshold alert, anomaly alert, and SLO-based alert.
2) SLO visual editor shows expected traffic window, error budget, and immediate preview of projected alert firing probability for next 1/6/24 hours.
3) Handoff timeline component displays last 72 hours of ownership changes, current owner, next scheduled owner, and an explicit 'escalate' affordance.
4) Microcopy reviewed and approved by PM and Support lead; copy reduces ambiguity for destination channels and severity mapping.
5) Postmortem quicklinks surface the most recent postmortem and relevant runbooks; clicking opens the record in a new tab.
6) Prototype usability test: >= 85% of participants complete alert creation without asking clarifying questions; mean task time < 4 minutes for threshold alert.
comments: 2025-03-16 - Ava Chen: Initial sketches uploaded to Figma. Focused on reducing number of fields on first step and pushing advanced options into 'expert mode'.
2025-03-17 - Liam Ortega: Iterated on SLO editor visuals — replaced numeric-only inputs with slider + histogram preview. Left a note to ask Reliability on histogram binning assumptions.
2025-03-18 - Maya Patel (PM): Reviewed microcopy. Suggested changing 'notify' language to 'alert' for consistency across console. Also requested prominent link to 'test alert' in the final step.

2025-03-19 - Jordan Ruiz (Support): Requested an explicit checkbox: 'Add postmortem link to alert' that copies the most recent incident for that service. Concern: privacy for customer-managed incidents.

2025-03-20 - Design Review: Prototype walkthrough with Eng and PM. Engineering flagged backend telemetry needed for predicted firing probability; moved that item to a dependency. Usability test plan approved.
2025-03-21 - Liam Ortega: Updated prototype to surface 'on-call notes' in the handoff timeline and added microcopy variants for A/B testing. Marking ticket In Review.
decisions: Ship the alert wizard in two tiers: 'Simple' (default) and 'Advanced' (expert mode) to reduce cognitive load for new users.
SLO visual editor will show projected alert risk using a client-side heuristic if backend risk scoring is unavailable; engineering to replace with telemetry-powered score later.
Handoff timeline will display a compact 72-hour view by default with an expand option; include one-click transferConfirm action tied to SSO identity.
Postmortem quicklinks will default to the most recent postmortem for the service but require explicit confirmation before copying into the alert body to respect privacy.
